title: Heavy rains to drench Metro Manila, Luzon areas on Saturday afternoon

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Heavy downpour may occur in Metro Manila and several areas in Luzon on Saturday afternoon, Sept. 19, brought by localized thunderstorms and the effects of the southwest monsoon, or habagat, the state weather bureau said. In a thunderstorm advisory issued at 2:30 p.m., the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said that heavy to intense rains with lightning and strong winds are expected over the following areas within the next two hours: READ: Habagat to bring rain to some areas in Luzon Meanwhile, similar weather conditions are affecting the areas as follows, which may persist within […]...
